failure: Atlas rejected a 41-byte generated tenant database name; the affected cluster accepts at most 38 bytes.
behavior: Preserve valid <=38-byte legacy names; otherwise use a three-character prefix and a 128-bit digest over the full base and owner. No database is renamed or deleted.
limitations: Local regression uses a mock client enforcing the actual Atlas name-length rule. Real deployment and existing database permissions were not changed or certified.
